Why should companies adopt customer targeting?

No business ever has unlimited resources at its disposal. In order to achieve the best results out of whatever is available, targeting is essential. Customer targeting is one such technique. It is a business process that defines and identifies which customers to market to. For every campaign that a company launches, a decision should be made about whom it will reach out to, and whom it won’t.

There are multiple factors to be considered before making such a decision. Some of these include: the type and cost of the media, past customer performance (recency, frequency and monetary), etc. Customers should also be segmented based on their age, gender, location, income, interests, etc. This will allow the strategist to showcase the way in which the product/service meets the desire/need of the customer. Customer Targeting The process aside, what are the advantages of customer targeting? How does it help a business get better leads and sales? One very basic advantage is that it helps specific products reach customers better. A strategist might find from his/her market research that people above the age of 35 often have teeth colouring problems; and hence decide to target the company’s whitening strips to that segment of users.

Companies that use targeting also have a better insight into what kind of customers will pay what price. Microsoft offers both an enterprise edition and a student edition of its popular Office software; and each is priced based on how much each of those segments will be willing to pay. In this way, Microsoft is able to maximize the revenues for the product it has developed.

Businesses which implement targeting are usually more efficient and effective in their advertising campaigns. They are more efficient because they don’t waste money advertising to people outside their target audience. Organizations using targeting are get better results because they reach the right potential customers with messages that are more relevant.

Use targeting, and get better reach; saving money at the same time!
